subject: [hw] V02 final routing table (supersedes my 11:37 post; T01/V10/V12 corrections applied)
body:
The 11:37 table had three wrong rows (A32 case 0, case 3, F4-F7). This is what emu/n2a32_core.c implements now; T01s A32 corpus, V12s 7/7 and V10s 12/12 checkers pass. One llvm-mc example per row is in emu/test_v02.

A32, cond != 0xF (first match wins):
1 (i&0x0F000000)==0x0F000000                       SVC -> arm_misc
2 (i&0x0E000000)==0x0E000000 (b27-25=111)          coproc data/register: cp=(i>>8)&15; cp10/11 -> vfp else arm_misc
3 (i&0x0E000000)==0x0C000000 (110)                 coproc load/store: cp10/11 -> vfp else arm_misc
4 (i&0x0E000000)==0x0A000000 (101)                 B/BL -> arm_misc
5 (i&0x0E000000)==0x08000000 (100)                 LDM/STM -> arm_mem
6 (i&0x0E000000)==0x06000000 (011):
   (i&0x0FF000F0)==0x07F000F0                      UDF -> arm_misc
   i&0x10                                          every media form has bit4 set -> arm_media
   else                                            LDR/STR register, P=0 and P=1 (incl. LDRT/STRT) -> arm_mem
7 (i&0x0E000000)==0x04000000 (010)                 LDR/STR/LDRB/STRB immediate -> arm_mem
8 (i&0x0E000000)==0x02000000 (001):
   (i&0x0FFFFF00)==0x0320F000                      NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/SEVL (imm8 in 7-0) -> arm_misc
   else                                            dp immediate, MOVW/MOVT, MSR imm -> arm_dp
9 (i&0x0E000000)==0x00000000 (000), consolidated T01/V10/V12:
   (i&0x0F0000F0)==0x00000090                      MUL/MLA/MLS/UMAAL/UMULL/UMLAL/SMULL/SMLAL -> arm_dp  [before LDRH!]
   (i&0x90)==0x90 and bits7-4 in {B,D,F} or (9 and bits11-8==F)
                                                   LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH/LDRD/STRD/LDREX/STREX, any P/U -> arm_mem
   (i&0x0F900FF0)==0x01000050                      QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB -> arm_media
   (i&0x0F900090)==0x01000080                      SMLAxy/SMULxy/SMLAWy/SMULWy/SMLALxy -> arm_media
   (i&0x0FF000F0)==0x01200070                      BKPT -> arm_misc
   bits23-20==2,19-16==15,11-8==15,bits7-4 in{1,3} BX/BLX(reg) -> arm_misc
   else                                            DP register (incl. MOV/MVN/ORR/BIC/TST/CMP shifted), MRS/MSR, CLZ -> arm_dp

A32, cond == 0xF, by top byte:
 F0/F1                                             CPS/SETEND/unconditional misc -> arm_misc
 F2/F3 (NEON data processing):
   bit23==0                                        neon_3same (V18)
   op5=(i>>19)&31: 0x10 with bit4 and bits7-5!=0   neon_misc (V20) [one-reg modified immediate]
                   op5<=0x15                      neon_shift (V19) [2reg+shift, 3 different lengths, 2reg+scalar, VMOVL]
                   else                           neon_misc (V20) [two-reg misc: VEXT/VTBL/VDUP/VREV/...]
 F4 (i&0xFF70F000)==0xF450F000                     PLI immediate, U=0 and U=1 -> arm_mem
    else                                           NEON structure ld/st -> neon_ldst (V20)
 F5 (i&0xFF70F000)==0xF550F000                     PLD immediate -> arm_mem
    (i&0xFF70F000)==0xF510F000                     PLDW immediate -> arm_mem
    (i&0xFFFFFFF0)==0xF57FF000                     DMB/DSB/ISB/CLREX -> arm_misc; else arm_misc
 F6/F7 (i&0xFF70F010)==0xF650F000                  PLI register -> arm_mem
       (i&0xFF70F010)==0xF750F000                  PLD register -> arm_mem
       (i&0xFF70F010)==0xF710F000                  PLDW register -> arm_mem; else arm_misc
 F8-FB                                             BLX imm / unconditional -> arm_misc
 FC/FD/FE cp10/11 -> vfp else arm_misc              LDC2/STC2/CDP2/MCR2/MRC2 (ARMv8 VFP VMAXNM/VRINT/VCVTA live here)
 FF                                                SVC -> arm_misc

T32 (hw1 = first halfword; hw1 >= 0xE800 = 32-bit):
 0xE800-0xE9FF                                     t32_mem (LDM/STM, LDRD/STRD, LDREX/STREX, TBB/TBH)
 0xEA00-0xEBFF                                     t32_dp (shifted/extended register, PKH)
 0xEC00-0xEEFF                                     coproc; cp10/11 -> vfp else t32_misc
 0xEF00-0xEFFF                                     NEON dp U=0: a32 = 0xF2000000|(i&0xFFFFFF)|((i&0x10000000)>>4), then F2/F3 split
 0xF000-0xF7FF hw2 bit15==1                        t32_misc (B/BL/BLX/B<c>, MRS/MSR, hints, barriers, UDF)
               hw2 bit15==0                        t32_dp (modified/plain immediate, MOVW/MOVT, bitfield, SSAT/USAT)
 0xF800-0xF9FF F8xx -> t32_mem
               F9xx with hw1 bit4 set -> t32_mem   (load/store single incl. LDRSB/LDRSH/PLD/PLI)
               F9xx with hw1 bit4 clear -> neon_ldst (V20), converted F9xx -> F4xx so V20 sees the A32 form
 0xFA00-0xFBFF                                     t32_dp (DP register, MUL/MLA/MLS/SDIV/UDIV/SMULL/...)
 0xFC00-0xFDFF                                     coproc; cp10/11 -> vfp else t32_misc
 0xFE00-0xFEFF                                     vfp (word unchanged: A32 and T32 are identical)
 0xFF00-0xFFFF                                     NEON dp U=1: a32 = 0xF3000000|(i&0xFFFFFF), then F2/F3 split
 all other 16-bit                                  t16

Notes: (a) T32 VFP words are passed unchanged, not with the top nibble forced to 0xE, because ARMv8 VFP is 0xFE...... in both sets. (b) T32 F9xx NEON structure ld/st is converted to the A32 F4xx form for V20; please check that is your expected form. (c) A32 0xF4 also contains PLI; the exact mask above keeps it out of neon_ldst.
